citations.quote: For theft of your covered auto, you must report the theft to the police within 48 hours of discovering it. We will pay for loss only after 30 days have passed without recovery of the vehicle, unless the vehicle is recovered earlier in damaged condition.

output.reasoning: The policy requires that a theft claim be paid only after 30 days have elapsed without recovery of the vehicle. The claim was filed before that 30‑day period has passed, so the coverage does not yet apply. No exclusions are triggered by the facts presented.
